allowed_path_overlaps.reason: Foundation spans L0-L6; data/foundation/ contains layer-specific and cross-layer files owned by foundation and l1/l2/l3.
Foundation includes formal/lean/ for formal proofs; L4 owns formal/ for general math models.
Foundation includes tests/foundation/ and tools/foundation/ for cross-layer validation; L5 owns them for evaluation methodology.
external_input, case_source and L6 all own docs/publication/cases/ (L6 owns docs/publication/, external_input and case_source own case sources).
L6, ignition_increment and point_fire_analysis share reports/publication/ for derived increments and analysis.
historical_reports and iteration_manifest_contract share reports/operations/ for historical ops and 121Q32 reports.
pages_pipeline owns pages/ for the deployment chain; system_map_projection owns the generated SVG under pages/generated/.
Q33 governance components share governance-related paths across data/, schemas/, tools/, tests/, and docs/. Includes charter and licensing which also live under docs/governance/.
